children: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) held 35.5% of x86 server CPU shipments in the third quarter, up from 27.8% a year earlier, according to analyst Jeff Pu.
Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) next-generation Venice processor shipments are forecast by Jeff Pu to rise from 400,000 in 2026 to 5.4 million in 2027.
AMD reported $7.75 billion in fiscal 2025 sales to China and Hong Kong, about 22% of its $34.6 billion revenue, plus $4.28 billion in sales to Singapore.
Hunterbrook’s affiliated investment fund disclosed a short position in Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD).
Law firms are investigating potential securities class actions alleging AMD misled investors about its ties to Chinese manufacturer IEIT Systems, following a report published the prior day.
U.S. authorities approved licenses for AMD MI325X chips among 879,000 advanced AI chips cleared for Chinese firms from December 2025 to May 2026. The number ultimately shipped remains unknown.
House Select Committee on China Chair John Moolenaar said congressional scrutiny of advanced-chip sales and exports to China extends beyond Nvidia and includes Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD).
Jim Cramer called a report targeting AMD a “hit job,” praised its latest earnings as an “amazing quarter” and said his charitable trust planned to buy shares after the stock fell.
David Tepper’s Appaloosa Management exited its position in Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD), which had totaled about 198,000 shares.
Robert Soros's investment firm reduced its holding in Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) from about 52,000 shares to 798 shares.
